passages.sermon:
This is a song.
People sing this song while going up to Jerusalem.
They call it a song of ascents.

passages.text: When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
The LORD restored the captives of Zion.
We felt like people who dream.
passages.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ שִׁיבַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הָ֝יִ֗ינוּ כְּחֹלְמִֽים׃

passages.text: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD restored the captives of Zion.
We were like people who dream.
Our mouths became full of laughter.
Our tongues shouted with joy.
People in other nations saw this.
They said, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
passages.original: אָ֤ז יִמָּלֵ֪א שְׂח֡וֹק פִּינוּ֮ וּלְשׁוֹנֵ֪נוּ רִ֫נָּ֥ה אָ֭ז יֹאמְר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם הִגְדִּ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִם־ אֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
passages.sermon: The LORD has done great things for us.\r\nWe are filled with joy.
passages.original: הִגְדִּ֣יל יְ֭הוָה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּ֗נוּ הָיִ֥ינוּ שְׂמֵחִֽים׃

passages.text: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
passages.sermon:
This is a prayer to the LORD.
The people ask God to restore their fortunes.
They want God to bring back their captives.
They compare this restoration to streams in the Negev.
The Negev is a dry desert.
When rain comes, streams fill the desert quickly.
The people want God to bring restoration suddenly and fully, like these streams.
passages.original: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ שְׁבוּתֵנוּ כַּאֲפִיקִ֥ים בַּנֶּֽגֶב׃

passages.text: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
passages.sermon:
God watches over His people.
Some people plant seeds while they cry.
These people feel sorrow and pain.
Later, these same people will gather a harvest.
They will shout with joy when they reap.
God turns sorrow into joy.

passages.text: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
passages.sermon:
A person leaves his home.
He weeps as he goes.
He carries a trail of seed with him.
He sows the seed while he is sad.
Later, he returns.
He shouts with joy as he comes back.
He carries sheaves of grain in his arms.
passages.original: הָ֘ל֤וֹךְ יֵלֵ֨ךְ׀ וּבָכֹה֮ נֹשֵׂ֪א מֶֽשֶׁךְ־ הַ֫זָּ֥רַע בֹּֽ֬א־ יָב֥וֹא בְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֝שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו׃
